name: Samsung

SDE-1 (Samsung R&D India).dsaDepth: Heavy — a single long coding question (3 hrs, 40-50 hidden test cases, standard-library and autocomplete banned) is the hardest filter, then a resume/DSA technical round and HR
rounds: Round 1 — Online exam on Samsung’s own "Samsung SWC" / "Samsung Advanced Test" platform: 1 large coding question in 3 hours, must pass ~40-50 hidden test cases, standard library functions and IDE autocomplete are disabled
Round 2 — Technical interview (~1-1.5 hrs): deep dive into resume/projects and the language used (Java OOP, garbage collection, string pool are commonly asked), then DSA/algorithms questions
Round 3 — HR/Managerial round: aptitude, puzzles, background
extraTopics: Writing correct code WITHOUT standard-library helpers or IDE autocomplete under a proctored 3-hour window — a distinctive constraint
Deep language-internals knowledge (e.g. Java garbage collection, memory model) alongside DSA
SDE-1 (Samsung R&D India).notes: Some pipelines run only 2 rounds (OA + one short technical call); others run the full 3-4 round loop — varies by campus vs off-campus and by specific R&D center (Bangalore, Noida).
